title: 内角纸片路线
description: 剪纸层叠让内角路线的两面墙与低脚点形成简明场景。

art_direction.medium: colored pencil sports sketch with layered visible pencil marks
art_direction.scene: An original layered-paper illustration shows a fictional fully clothed adult following a compact low route inside a shallow corner. Large orange handholds and broad blue footholds alternate across the two wall planes, supporting a comfortable stance and a short nearby hand reach. Keep both shoes close to thick continuous crash mats, with no extreme split or high exposure. Use a wide oblique composition that includes the whole adult, visible paper fibers, gentle stacked shadows, and generous empty landing space. Cream and sage wall layers create an original geometric gym setting. Make the limbs proportionate and contact points readable. Include no captions, brands, leaps, or portrait framing.
